title: darrylmorley/whatcable
claim: darrylmorley/whatcable — macOS menu bar app that tells you, in plain English, what each USB-C cable plugged into your Mac can actually do
why_good: Solves the everyday USB-C guessing game — which cable does 100W? 40Gbps? — right in the menu bar; a real annoyance with a clear, narrow scope.
value: A cheap paid Mac utility (one-time or small subscription) for pros with drawers of identical-looking cables; expand into a cable-identifier database.
risk: Tiny scope and easily cloned; Apple could surface this natively and free alternatives can appear fast.

zh.claim: darrylmorley/whatcable —— macOS 菜单栏 app,用大白话告诉你插进 Mac 的每根 USB-C 线到底能干什么(供电/速率)。
zh.why_good: 解决 USB-C 的日常猜谜——哪根线能 100W?40Gbps?——直接在菜单栏给答案,痛点真实、范围清晰。
zh.value: 给一抽屉长得一样的线的专业用户卖个便宜的 Mac 小工具(一次性或小额订阅),再扩成线材识别数据库。
zh.risk: 范围小、易被抄;Apple 可能原生做掉,免费替代也会很快冒出来。
zh.hook: 终于搞清每根 USB-C 线到底能干嘛——就在 Mac 菜单栏里。

hook: Finally know what each USB-C cable can actually do — right in your Mac's menu bar.
